gloss: prayer; vow (to a god or buddha)

definitions.gloss: prayer; vow (made to a god or buddha)
definitions.explanation: A prayer to a god or buddha for something one wants, often with a promise attached, such as giving up a favorite food until the wish comes true. Almost always in {願|がん}を{掛|か}ける.

examples.english: To make a vow to the gods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{願|がん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けた。
examples.english: I went to the shrine and prayed to pass the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧な⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{断|た}って{願|がん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My mother gave up the sweets she loved as a vow to the gods, so that my illness would get better.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {願|がん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to make a vow or prayer to a god or buddha
- {願掛|がんか}け: making such a vow
- {大願|たいがん}: a great wish, a long-held ambition

CULTURAL NOTE:
A traditional {願掛|がんか}け often involves giving something up until the wish is granted, such as tea ({茶断|ちゃだ}ち) or salt ({塩断|しおだ}ち), or visiting a shrine many times. When the wish comes true, one goes back to give thanks (お{礼参|れいまい}り).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧: wish, request — the everyday word, used for any wish, religious or not
- ⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧: prayer for something — ⟦{合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}→合格祈願：29108_goukakukigan⟧ (praying to pass an exam)
